limitations: This is one mixed full-match trajectory and does not close aggregate request safety for all Prompt 4 states or all commands.
Fallback/no_decision remains present; zero invalid replies in this trajectory does not prove zero invalid replies in the wider game.
Per-command provenance is available here; per-skill provenance is only partial in this trajectory (one allowlisted entry) and is not a matched baseline/candidate comparison.

The run is not a Prompt 4-only denominator and does not measure resource value, downstream effect, target quality, win rate, reconnect, physical-device readiness, release/rollback or canary stability.
The package manifest revision is retained for the isolated runner while packageSha256 identifies the staged working-tree QA tree; no clean-commit or production-release claim follows.
No raw logs, credentials, card/target IDs, private hands/generals, prompts or exception payloads are stored in this artifact.
